description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to notification messages used in Orleans' event sourcing system, including a base interface, a version notification, and a batched notification message.

classes.name: VersionNotificationMessage
classes.description: A notification message containing only a version number, used to indicate a specific version in the system.

classes.name: BatchedNotificationMessage
classes.description: A notification message that contains a batch of other notification messages, with a maximum version derived from its contents.

methods.name: VersionNotificationMessage.Version
methods.description: Property representing the version number of the notification message.

methods.name: BatchedNotificationMessage.Version
methods.description: Property that computes the maximum version among all contained notification messages.
